### Germination Data ###

```{r Germination}
# =========================
# 1. Load libraries
# =========================
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(emmeans)

# =========================
# 2. Import data
# =========================
germ_data <- read_excel(
  "C:/Users/jwl0037/Downloads/biochartree.xlsx",
  sheet = "germination",
  range = "A1:D13"  # adjust if needed
)

# =========================
# 3. Clean & transform
# =========================
germ_data <- germ_data %>%
  mutate(
    species = factor(species),
    biochar_level = factor(biochar_level, levels = c("0", "25", "50", "100")),
    germ_rate = (germinated / sowed) * 100  # germination rate in %
  )

# =========================
# 4. Statistical analysis
# =========================

# Two-way ANOVA: germination rate ~ species * biochar level
anova_germ <- aov(germ_rate ~ species * biochar_level, data = germ_data)
summary(anova_germ)

# Optional: Tukey post-hoc test for species differences
# tukey_species <- TukeyHSD(anova_germ, which = "species")
# tukey_species

# Optional: emmeans for pairwise comparisons
# emmeans(model, pairwise ~ species, adjust = "tukey")

# =========================
# 5. Summarize data
# =========================

# By species
summary_species <- germ_data %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rate = mean(germ_rate),
    se_rate = sd(germ_rate) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(summary_species)

# By biochar level
summary_biochar <- germ_data %>%
  group_by(biochar_level) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rate = mean(germ_rate),
    se_rate = sd(germ_rate) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(summary_biochar)

# By species + biochar (for plotting if needed)
summary_species_biochar <- germ_data %>%
  group_by(species, biochar_level) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rate = mean(germ_rate),
    se_rate = sd(germ_rate) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# =========================
# 6. (Optional) Plot: Germination
# =========================
# Uncomment and adjust if you want a bar plot similar to survival/respiration plots

# ggplot(summary_species_biochar, aes(x = species, y = mean_rate, fill = biochar_level)) +
#   geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
#   geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_rate - se_rate, ymax = mean_rate + se_rate),
#                 width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
#   labs(x = "Species", y = "Mean Germination Rate (%)", fill = "Biochar Level (%)") +
#   theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

```

### Survival Data and Figures 1 ###

```{r Survival and Fig 1}
library(readxl); library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(scales)

# 1. Import & clean data
surv_data <- read_excel("C:/Users/jlsoc/Downloads/biochartree.xlsx",
                        sheet="survival", range="A1:F145") %>%
  mutate(
    survival = as.numeric(suppressWarnings(survival)),  # NAs expected
    survival_rate = survival / seeded,
    species = recode(species,
                     "ll"="Longleaf Pine",
                     "lob"="Loblolly Pine",
                     "sl"="Slash Pine"),
    fertilizer = factor(fertilizer,
                        levels=c("none","half","full","double"),
                        labels=c("none","1/2-standard","standard","2×-standard")),
    biochar_percent = as.factor(`biochar_%`)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(survival_rate), !is.na(fertilizer), !is.na(biochar_percent), !is.na(species))

# 2. ANOVA across species
anova_model <- aov(survival_rate ~ fertilizer * biochar_percent * species, data=surv_data)
summary(anova_model)

# 3. Summarize for plotting
summary_data <- surv_data %>%
  group_by(species, fertilizer, biochar_percent) %>%
  summarise(mean_survival = mean(survival_rate, na.rm=TRUE)*100,
            se_survival = sd(survival_rate, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(sum(!is.na(survival_rate)))*100,
            .groups="drop")

# 4. Plot
ggplot(summary_data, aes(x=fertilizer, y=mean_survival, fill=biochar_percent)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position=position_dodge(0.8)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean_survival - se_survival,
                    ymax=mean_survival + se_survival),
                width=0.2, position=position_dodge(0.8)) +
  facet_wrap(~species) +
  labs(y="Mean Survival Rate (%)", x="Fertilizer Rate", fill="Biochar Level (%)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("0"="#440154","25"="#31688E","50"="#35B779","100"="#D9F0A3")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=number_format(scale=1), expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.1))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size=13) +
  theme(panel.border=element_rect(color="black", fill=NA, size=0.5),
        strip.background=element_rect(fill="gray90", color="black"),
        strip.text=element_text(face="bold"),
        axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1),
        legend.position = "bottom"
        )
# ggsave("survival_plot.png", plot = p_survival, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```

### CO2 Flux Rates Data and Figure 2 & 3 ###

```{r CO2 Flux and Fig 2 & 3}
# =========================
# 1. Load libraries
# =========================
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpattern)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(ggpubr)
library(Matrix)

# =========================
# 2. Import data
# =========================
resp <- read_excel(
  "C:/Users/jlsoc/Downloads/biochartree.xlsx",
  sheet = "respiration",
  range = "A1:E193"
)

# Optional: remove specific outlier (replication 2 & day 2)
resp <- resp %>%
  mutate(respiration = ifelse(replication == 2 & day == 2, NA, respiration))

# =========================
# 3. Clean & transform
# =========================
resp <- resp %>%
  mutate(
    biochar_ratio = factor(biochar_ratio, levels = c(0, 25, 50, 100),
                           labels = c("0%", "25%", "50%", "100%")),
    fertilizer = factor(fertilizer, levels = c("none", "half", "full", "double"),
                        labels = c("none", "1/2-standard", "standard", "2×-standard")),
    day = factor(day),
    replication = factor(replication)
  )

# =========================
# 4. Summarize data
# =========================

# Summary by biochar
biochar_summary <- resp %>%
  group_by(biochar_ratio) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_resp = mean(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_resp = sd(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(respiration)),
    se_resp = sd_resp / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(plot_type = "Biochar Level",
         sig_letter = c("a", "a", "a", "b"))  # example letters

# Summary by fertilizer
fert_summary <- resp %>%
  group_by(fertilizer) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_resp = mean(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_resp = sd(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(respiration)),
    se_resp = sd_resp / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(plot_type = "Fertilizer Rate",
         sig_letter = c("b", "b", "b", "a"))  # example letters

# Combine summaries for plotting
combined_summary <- bind_rows(biochar_summary, fert_summary)

# Summary by biochar + fertilizer (for patterned bars)
combined_summary <- resp %>%
  group_by(biochar_ratio, fertilizer) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_resp = mean(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_resp = sd(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(respiration)),
    se_resp = sd_resp / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    biochar_fert = interaction(biochar_ratio, fertilizer, sep = "_"),
    biochar_fert = factor(biochar_fert,
                           levels = c(
                             "0%_none", "0%_1/2-standard", "0%_standard", "0%_2×-standard",
                             "25%_none", "25%_1/2-standard", "25%_standard", "25%_2×-standard",
                             "50%_none", "50%_1/2-standard", "50%_standard", "50%_2×-standard",
                             "100%_none", "100%_1/2-standard", "100%_standard", "100%_2×-standard"
                           ))
  )

# =========================
# 5. Statistical analysis
# =========================
# ANOVA for respiration
resp_clean <- resp %>% filter(!is.na(respiration))
model_aov <- aov(respiration ~ fertilizer * biochar_ratio * day, data = resp_clean)
summary(model_aov)

# Optional TukeyHSD post-hoc tests
# TukeyHSD(model_aov, which = "fertilizer")
# TukeyHSD(model_aov, which = "biochar_ratio")
# TukeyHSD(model_aov, which = "fertilizer:biochar_ratio")

# =========================
# 6. Plot: Respiration with patterns
# =========================
x_labels <- rep(levels(combined_summary$fertilizer), times = length(levels(combined_summary$biochar_ratio)))

ggplot(combined_summary, aes(x = biochar_fert, y = mean_resp,
                             fill = biochar_ratio, pattern = biochar_ratio)) +
  geom_bar_pattern(
    stat = "identity",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0),
    pattern_fill = "black",
    pattern_angle = 45,
    pattern_density = 0,
    pattern_spacing = 0.05
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_resp - se_resp, ymax = mean_resp + se_resp),
                width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Biochar Level (%)",
    values = c("0%" = "#440154",
               "25%" = "#31688E",
               "50%" = "#35B779", 
               "100%" = "#D9F0A3"),
    labels = c("0%", "25%", "50%", "100%")
  ) +
  scale_pattern_manual(
    values = c("0" = "none",
               "25" = "none",
               "50" = "none",
               "100" = "none"),
    name = "Biochar Level (%)"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(pattern = c("none", "stripe", "crosshatch", "circle"))),
    pattern = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
  labs(x = "Fertilizer Rates",
       y = expression("Mean CO "[2]~"flux rates (µmol CO"[2]~"m"^{-2}~"s"^{-1}*")")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

```

```{r}
library(readxl)

# =========================
resp <- read_excel(

  sheet = "respiration",
  range = "A1:E193"
)

# Remove specific outlier (optional)
resp <- resp %>%
  mutate(respiration = ifelse(replication == 2 & day == 2, NA, respiration))

# Clean & factor variables
resp <- resp %>%
  mutate(
    biochar_ratio = factor(biochar_ratio, levels = c(0, 25, 50, 100),
                           labels = c("0%", "25%", "50%", "100%")),
    fertilizer = factor(fertilizer, levels = c("none", "half", "full", "double"),
                        labels = c("none", "1/2-standard", "standard", "2×-standard")),
    day = factor(day),
    replication = factor(replication)
  )

# =========================
# 2. Summarize data by biochar + fertilizer
# =========================
combined_summary <- resp %>%
  group_by(biochar_ratio, fertilizer) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_resp = mean(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_resp   = sd(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
    n         = sum(!is.na(respiration)),
    se_resp   = sd_resp / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    biochar_fert = interaction(biochar_ratio, fertilizer, sep = "_"),
    biochar_fert = factor(biochar_fert,
                           levels = c(
                             "0%_none", "0%_1/2-standard", "0%_standard", "0%_2×-standard",
                             "25%_none", "25%_1/2-standard", "25%_standard", "25%_2×-standard",
                             "50%_none", "50%_1/2-standard", "50%_standard", "50%_2×-standard",
                             "100%_none", "100%_1/2-standard", "100%_standard", "100%_2×-standard"
                           ))
  )

# =========================
# 3. Join significant letters
# =========================
# letters_df should have columns: fertilizer, biochar_ratio, sig_letter
combined_summary <- combined_summary %>%
  left_join(letters_df, by = c("fertilizer", "biochar_ratio"))

# =========================
# 4. Plot with error bars and letters
# =========================
x_labels <- rep(levels(combined_summary$fertilizer), times = length(levels(combined_summary$biochar_ratio)))
letter_offset <- 0.005  # adjust this value to move letters higher/lower

ggplot(combined_summary, aes(x = biochar_fert, y = mean_resp, fill = biochar_ratio)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_resp - se_resp, ymax = mean_resp + se_resp),
                width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_letter,
                y = mean_resp + se_resp + letter_offset),  # letters above error bars
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
            size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Biochar Level (%)",
    values = c("0%" = "#440154",
               "25%" = "#31688E",
               "50%" = "#35B779", 
               "100%" = "#D9F0A3"),
    labels = c("0%", "25%", "50%", "100%")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +  # leave extra space at top
  labs(
    x = "Fertilizer Rates",
    y = expression("Mean CO "[2]~"flux rates (µmol CO"[2]~"m"^{-2}~"s"^{-1}*")")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

## Fig. 2 ##
```{r respiration}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)     
library(emmeans) 
library(ggpubr) 
library(Matrix)

#resp <- read_excel("C:/Users/jlsoc/Downloads/biochartree.xlsx", sheet="respiration", range="A1:E193")
resp <- read_excel("C:/Users/jwl0037/Downloads/biochartree.xlsx", sheet="respiration", range="A1:E193")
#head(resp)

resp <- resp %>%
  mutate(respiration = ifelse(replication == 2 & day == 2, NA, respiration))

#------------ 

resp$biochar_ratio <- as.factor(resp$biochar_ratio)
resp$day <- as.factor(resp$day)
resp$fertilizer <- as.factor(resp$fertilizer)

#------------ 


biochar_summary <- resp %>%
  group_by(biochar_ratio) %>%
  summarize(mean_resp = mean(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_resp = sd(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n(),
            se_resp = sd_resp / sqrt(n)) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(biochar_ratio,
                       levels = c(0, 25, 50, 100),
                       labels = c("0%", "25%", "50%", "100%")),
    plot_type = "Biochar Level"
  )

# Summarize by fertilizer
fert_summary <- resp %>%
  group_by(fertilizer) %>%
  summarize(mean_resp = mean(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_resp = sd(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n(),
            se_resp = sd_resp / sqrt(n)) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(
      fertilizer,
      levels = c("none", "half", "full", "double"),
      labels = c("none", "1/2-standard", "standard", "2×-standard")
    ),
    plot_type = "Fertilizer Rate"
  )


# significant letters
  # Biochar letters: 0%, 25%, 50%, 100%
  biochar_summary$sig_letter <- c("a", "a", "a", "b")

  # Fertilizer letters: none, half, full, double
  fert_summary$sig_letter <- c("b", "b", "b", "a")
  
# Combine both
combined_summary <- bind_rows(biochar_summary, fert_summary)

# Plot
ggplot(combined_summary, aes(x = treatment, y = mean_resp, fill = plot_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_resp - se_resp, ymax = mean_resp + se_resp),
                width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_letter, y = mean_resp + se_resp + 0.005),  # 0.02 is offset above error bar
            position = position_dodge(0.9), size = 5) +
  facet_wrap(~ plot_type, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "Treatment",
       y = expression("Mean CO"[2]~"flux rates (µmol CO "[2]~"m"^{-2}~"s"^{-1}*")")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Biochar Level" = "#31688E", "Fertilizer Rate" = "#35B779")) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",  # 🚫 Remove legend entirely
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),  # ✅ Box around each facet
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "black"),  # Optional: box around facet labels
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

#------------

resp %>%
  group_by(fertilizer, biochar_ratio, day) %>%
  summarise(mean_resp = mean(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_resp = sd(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = sum(!is.na(respiration))) %>%
  arrange(fertilizer, biochar_ratio, day)

#--------
 
resp_clean <- resp %>% filter(!is.na(respiration))

# Convert factors
resp_clean <- resp_clean %>%
  mutate(
    fertilizer = factor(fertilizer),
    biochar_ratio = factor(biochar_ratio),
    day = factor(day),
    replication = factor(replication)
  )

model_aov <- aov(respiration ~ fertilizer * biochar_ratio * day, data = resp_clean)
#TukeyHSD(model_aov, which = "fertilizer")

full_anova <- aov(respiration ~ fertilizer * biochar_ratio * day, data = resp)
#summary(full_anova)

#TukeyHSD(full_anova, which ="fertilizer")
#TukeyHSD(full_anova, which ="biochar_ratio")
```

### Biomass Data ###

```{r Biomass}
library(readxl); library(dplyr); library(ggplot2)

bio_data <- read_excel("C:/Users/jlsoc/Downloads/biochartree.xlsx", 
                       sheet = "biomass", range = "A1:D49") %>%
  mutate(
    species = recode(species, "lob"="Loblolly Pine", "ll"="Longleaf Pine", "sl"="Slash Pine"),
    species = factor(species, levels = c("Loblolly Pine", "Longleaf Pine", "Slash Pine")),
    fertilizer = factor(fertilizer, levels = c("none","half","full","double"),
                        labels = c("none","1/2-standard","standard","2×-standard")),
    biochar = factor(biochar, levels = c(0,25,50,100))
  )

# -------------------------
# 2. Descriptive stats per species × fertilizer × biochar
# -------------------------
treatment_summary <- bio_data %>%
  group_by(species, fertilizer, biochar) %>%
  summarise(mean_biomass = mean(biomass, na.rm=TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
print("Descriptive stats per treatment combination:")
print(treatment_summary)

# -------------------------
# 3. Average biomass per fertilizer (averaging biochar)
# -------------------------
fert_summary <- bio_data %>%
  group_by(species, fertilizer) %>%
  summarise(mean_biomass = mean(biomass, na.rm=TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
print("Average biomass per fertilizer (all biochar levels combined):")
print(fert_summary)

# -------------------------
# 4. Average biomass per biochar (averaging fertilizer)
# -------------------------
biochar_summary <- bio_data %>%
  group_by(species, biochar) %>%
  summarise(mean_biomass = mean(biomass, na.rm=TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
print("Average biomass per biochar (all fertilizer levels combined):")
print(biochar_summary)

# -------------------------
# 5. Bar plot: biomass per seedling
# -------------------------
ggplot(treatment_summary,
       aes(x = biochar, y = mean_biomass, fill = fertilizer)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  facet_wrap(~ species) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Fertilizer Rate",
    values = c(
      "none" = "#440154",
      "1/2-standard" = "#31688E",
      "standard" = "#35B779",
      "2×-standard" = "#D9F0A3"
    ),
    labels = c("none", "1/2-standard", "standard", "2×-standard")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Biochar Level (%)",
    y = "Total dry biomass per seedling (g)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r RSR}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)     
library(emmeans) 
library(ggpubr) 
library(Matrix)
library(ggpattern)

# Read and recode
#rsr <- read_excel("C:/Users/jwl0037/Downloads/biochartree.xlsx", sheet="rsr", range="A1:D49")
rsr <- read_excel("C:/Users/jlsoc/Downloads/biochartree.xlsx", sheet="rsr", range="A1:D49")

rsr <- rsr %>%
  mutate(
    species = recode(species,
                     "ll" = "Longleaf Pine",
                     "lob" = "Loblolly Pine",
                     "sl" = "Slash Pine"),
    fertilizer = factor(fertilizer, 
                        levels = c("none", "half", "full", "double"),
                        labels = c("none", "1/2-standard", "standard", "2×-standard"))
  )

# Optional filter — remove if plotting all species
rsr_sl <- rsr %>%
  filter(species == "Slash Pine")

# Optional summary
rsr_summary <- rsr_sl %>%
  group_by(biochar_ratio, fertilizer) %>%
  summarise(
    se_RSR = sd(mean_RSR, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot with boxed panels
ggplot(rsr, aes(x = factor(biochar_ratio), y = mean_RSR, fill = fertilizer, pattern = fertilizer)) +
  geom_bar_pattern(
    stat = "identity",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    pattern_fill = "black",
    pattern_angle = 45,
    pattern_density = 0.01,
    pattern_spacing = 0.05
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ species) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Fertilizer Rate",
    values = c("none" = "#440154",
               "1/2-standard" = "#31688E",
               "standard" = "#35B779",
               "2×-standard" = "#D9F0A3"),
    labels = c("none", "1/2-standard", "standard", "2×-standard")
  ) +
  scale_pattern_manual(
    values = c("none" = "none",
               "1/2-standard" = "none",
               "standard" = "none",
               "2×-standard" = "none"),
    name = "Fertilizer Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Biochar Level (%)", 
       y = "Mean Root-to-Shoot Ratio", 
       title = "",
       fill = "Fertilizer Rate") +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "black"),  # grey box behind facet labels
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")                            # bold text in strips
  )
```
